text: ＊には　ぜんぜんきいてない！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows a state that is going on now; ていない is its 'not' form, and てない is the shortened spoken form. きいてない = 'it is not having any effect'.

patterns.name: ぜんぜん〜ない
patterns.explanation: ぜんぜん together with a 'not' ending means 'not at all'. ぜんぜんきいてない = 'it isn't working at all'.
